name: Polish Library in Paris

summary.text: The Polish Library in Paris is a Polish cultural centre of national importance and is closely associated both with the historic Great Emigration of the Polish élite to Paris in the 19th century and the formation in 1832 of the Literary Society, later the Historical and Literary Society.
